{"consolidated_memory":"CONSOLIDATED MEMORY: Empty Result Set in search/query/rewriter.ts - Three Separate Incidents

All three incidents occurred in search/query/rewriter.ts (search side). All shared the same symptom (rewritten query with no clauses left) and the same reproduction step (search for a two word phrase with a stop word). The same corner of the file was worked in all three cases, so context carried over between fixes.

---

INCIDENT 1 [2026-03-04]
Root Cause: Schema drift between the migration and the model
Trigger: Occurred only with traffic arriving through the corporate proxy
Fix: Regenerated the model from the migration and pinned the checksum
PR: #3134 on branch fix/empty-result-set-1
Outcome: Error rate dropped from 5.0% to under 4 per 10,000

---

INCIDENT 2 [2026-04-13]
Root Cause: Mutable default argument shared across calls
Trigger: Occurred only after a rolling restart of the fleet
Fix: Made the default empty and built the value per call
PR: #5391 on branch fix/empty-result-set-2
Outcome: Alert stayed quiet for 9 consecutive days

---

INCIDENT 3 [2026-04-22]
Root Cause: Race condition in lazy initialisation when two requests raced on the same key
Trigger: Occurred only when two requests raced on the same key
Fix: Guarded the initialization with a double-checked lock
PR: #8294 on branch fix/empty-result-set-3
Outcome: Throughput rose 87%, to 716 requests per second"}
